title: AnimationTree, blendspace point name doesn't update
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: v4.7.beta1.official [1c8cc9e7e]
Showing names on blendspace points was introduced in 4.7, because there are no point names in v4.6.2.stable.official [71f334935].

### System information

Godot v4.7.beta1 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - GeForce GTX 550 Ti - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-2100 CPU @ 3.10GHz (4 threads) - 11.95 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

In an AnimationTree, the blendspace point name don't update when the points animation is changed.
It's just an issue with the point name not updating the animation changes as expected.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/70133302-6b39-465d-9e8d-5081c59d45be

### Steps to reproduce

- open the project: [blendspace-point-name-doesn't-update.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27298921/blendspace-point-name-doesn.t-update.zip)
- in the scene panel, click on: animationtree
- in the bottom animationtree panel, right-click anywhere and choose: add animation > one
- a blendspace point was added with the name: one
the viewport plays animation one: 
  - the icon rotates clockwise 
  - and the label says: animation: one

- click on the blendspace point to select it
- in the inspector, click on the animation dropdown list, and choose: two

Issue:
The blendspace point still says: one
It's just an issue with the point name not updating.
The animation has changed, the viewport plays animation two:
- the icon rotates counter-clockwise
- and the label says: animation: two

Expected:
Update the blendspace point name to show the current animation name.

Tests failed:
The original blendspace point name remains after:
- closing and reopening the scene
- restarting Godot

Workaround:
The current workaround seems to require deleting the point and adding it with the expected animation name.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[blendspace-point-name-doesn't-update.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27298921/blendspace-point-name-doesn.t-update.zip)
